title: Labadain-MedQA: A Tetun Medical QA Dataset for Fine-Tuning and Evaluating Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.00935v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have created opportunities for cross-lingual transfer of medical knowledge from high-resource to low-resource languages to support access to healthcare information. However, medical question-answering (QA) datasets for fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs remain scarce for Tetun. To address this gap, we translated MedAlpaca's Medical Flashcards and WikiDoc Patient Information collections into Tetun using Gemini 2.5 Flash, producing 39,077 medical QA pairs. Translation quality was assessed on 50 randomly sampled QA pairs (100 documents) using automatic metrics against human reference translations and evaluations by two native Tetun-speaking healthcare professionals, focusing on medical accuracy and Tetun fluency. translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的进展为医疗知识从高资源语言向低资源语言的跨语言迁移创造了机会，以支持人们获取医疗保健信息。然而，用于微调和评估LLM的医疗问答（QA）数据集在德顿语中仍然稀缺。为填补这一空白，我们使用Gemini 2.5 Flash将MedAlpaca的医学闪卡和WikiDoc患者信息集合翻译成德顿语，生成了39,077个医疗问答对。翻译质量通过对50个随机抽取的问答对（100个文档）进行评估，采用自动指标与人工参考翻译对比，并由两名以德顿语为母语的医疗专业人员进行评估，重点关注医学准确性和德顿语流畅性。人工翻译在两项标准上的平均评分均高于LLM生成的翻译（4.43/5 对比 4.02/5），差异具有统计学显著性（Wilcoxon符号秩检验，p <...）（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了首个大规模德顿语医疗问答数据集Labadain-MedQA，包含39,077个问答对，通过将MedAlpaca医学数据集翻译成德顿语并进行人机翻译质量对比评估，为低资源语言的医疗LLM微调与评估提供了宝贵资源。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Labadain-MedQA, a large-scale Tetun medical QA dataset with 39,077 QA pairs created by translating MedAlpaca's medical collections using Gemini 2.5 Flash, with translation quality assessed against human references, providing a valuable resource for fine-tuning and evaluating medical LLMs in low-resource languages.
